visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair tied back, wearing a black leather jacket over a beige top and black shorts, sits at a wooden upright piano in a bright white studio. She smiles and gestures broadly with both arms extended to the sides. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up as she raises her hand with five fingers spread, indicating the number five. Bold yellow and purple text overlays appear beside her head. (3) A fast-paced montage features a young boy in a traditional yellow Chinese imperial costume and sunglasses, holding a violin against a pink graphic background with lightning bolt motifs. (4) The woman reappears in the studio wearing dark sunglasses, maintaining a stiff, stoic expression. A small pixelated character head appears in the bottom left corner. (5) She points toward the camera as icons representing difficulty levels, such as a baby face and a digital piano graphic, pop up on the screen. (6) The woman leans closer to the piano, looking at sheet music or a screen off-camera, her facial expressions shifting rapidly between concentration and laughter while her hands move near the keys. (7) The video concludes with a festive red background decorated with gold coins and a traditional window frame; the woman's face is centered in a circle as she pouts playfully toward the camera while text scrolls underneath.
